Title: Emotion Picker Screen
Context: Emotion picker screen for HoneyDo2Done, a therapeutic household management app, inspired by mindfulness and 'How We Feel' aesthetics.
Description of the screen: A therapeutic emotion picker screen with a deep charcoal black (#0D0D0D) background. At the top center, 'How's this making you feel?' is written in a clean white font. The core content is a 2x2 grid of four large, soft-gradient circular buttons (approx 140px diameter) with generous spacing. Top Left: Coral red to orange gradient ('High Energy Unpleasant'). Top Right: Yellow to amber gradient ('High Energy Pleasant'). Bottom Left: Blue to purple gradient ('Low Energy Unpleasant'). Bottom Right: Teal to green gradient ('Low Energy Pleasant'). Labels are centered inside each circle in white text. A subtle, muted 'Skip' button is at the bottom. The overall vibe is calm, reflective, and inviting.
Platform: web
Form factor: desktop
